name: leadflow-ai
description: LeadFlow AI — website chatbot + voice agent for inbound lead qualification, with KB-grounded answers, calendar booking, CRM sync, human handoff, and multi-language support.

scripts.dev: npm run build:widget && concurrently -k -n web,widget -c blue,green "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:widget"
scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build:web
scripts.db:schema: echo '⚠️  Apply infra/supabase/schema.sql in the Supabase SQL Editor.'
scripts.db:seed: echo '⚠️  Apply infra/supabase/seed.sql in the Supabase SQL Editor.'
scripts.n8n:workflows: echo 'ℹ️  Import JSON files from n8n/workflows/ via the n8n UI: Workflows -> + -> Import from File.'
